description:
Is Xi Jinping betting on “new quality productive forces” to save the economy? Robots break everywhere, AI “raise lobster” flops in one week, “Xi-style new engine” crashes on every road! Breaking down the 15th Five-Year Plan: GDP target drops for the first time ever, the real truth about China’s economy after real estate dies out.

China Insights delivers sharp, data-driven analysis of China’s politics, economy, and society.
We connect the dots behind breaking headlines — from Beijing’s power shifts to global market trends — helping viewers understand the real forces shaping modern China.
Stay informed. Stay ahead.
title: Is Xi Jinping betting on “new quality productive forces” to save the economy?
